Generate a 3x3 sprite sheet (square cells, identical size) of the same character, all on a SOLID #00FF00 green background. Match the LAYOUT and FRAMING of the attached reference image exactly.   Row 3: East knocked out (lying down) / East cheering / East wounded

Character: Former Emberguard captain with twenty-two years of service, fourteen commendations, and one resignation. Resigned rather than carry out an order to burn a village on cult-sympathizer grounds that didn
EQUIPMENT: humanoid character — may carry the weapon and/or shield described in the description. If no weapon/shield is mentioned, default to a sensible weapon for the class.

DO NOT draw any dark frame, outline, border, gridlines, or panel around cells — the green background must extend all the way to the edge of each cell without any dividing lines or contrasting trim.
